documents.title: ECRS Leadership

documents.title: ECRS Leadership Competency Model
documents.description: A guide to being a good leader: a list of things to aim for and strive to do well. Use it on your own, as a starting point for conversations with a mentor, or during prearranged observations to give a leader feedback.
